profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Skills: 
Troubleshooting software and hardware issues. 
Software design and implementation in a variety of languages, including C++ and Web development (HTML, CSS, Javascript)
7+ years of customer service in a retail or technology environment.

positions.title: Development Operations Engineer I
positions.description:
Lead cross-divisional alert notification and maturity project, enhancing IT-wide communication and response efficiency
Orchestrated comprehensive asset migration to Jira, centralizing resources and improving ITSD team support
Maintain and enhance Azure infrastructure using Pulumi, implementing hub-and-spoke architecture for development team
Collaborate with development and systems teams to migrate on-premise applications to modern server environments

 - I work with IT administration and service desk to make their jobs jobs easier and fill gaps in functionality.

positions.title: UX Designer
positions.description: Redesign and relaunch Ecommerce focused website
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify · E-Commerce · Web Design · User Experience (UX) · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Maintains full-stack web application using Vue for the frontend and Ruby on Rails for the backend
● Develops new features to meet expanding business requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · PostgreSQL · Front-End Development · Computer Science · PRY · Amazon ECS · Documentation · Git · Ruby on Rails · Software Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Modernized product onboarding application by replacing monolith with microservices
● Implemented GraphQL and Java endpoints that connected with DynamoDB and legacy database
● Researched, documented, and wrote descriptive tickets for future migration work 

● Adapted the One Click payment platform for CommerceTools Applications on a shortened timeline
● Created an Oracle Commerce Reference store implementation of the One Click Checkout
● Implemented One Click Checkout on an existing Oracle Commerce Application

● Led a team of Junior Developers gamifying internal projects
● Tracked statistics via Node.js AWS Lambdas reaching out to Gitlab API and Jira API
● Stored data in DynamoDB via Lambda implemented API Gateway endpoints
● Notified employees of achievements via Slackbot and Confluence Leaderboard
● Led stakeholder meetings, requirement meetings, and onboarded and offboarded team members

● Designed a web application that allowed employees to easily configure a company email signature
● Implemented React frontend, Terraform configuration, Gitlab CI/CD, and hosted with AWS S3

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Gitlab · C++ · TypeScript · Java · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Computer Science · Spring Boot · React.js · SQL · Oracle Commerce · Postman API · Python (Programming Language) · Documentation · GitHub · Git · Bash · Software Development · GraphQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · HTML · Linux

positions.title: Information Technology Work Study
positions.description:
-Troubleshooting software, resetting passwords and managing Gonzaga user accounts
-Introduce and encourage the use of VR technology, Laser Cutting, and 3d Printing
-Providing customer service for the Gonzaga community via walk in or phone call
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Computer Science · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML
